prototypeFunction: function renderDetailed(base,facility,proof){let total=base,rows=[['상조 서비스','다함상조 선택 상품',won(base)]],missing=[];if(!chosen){missing.push('장례식장 미선택')}else if(facility?.available){rows.push(['빈소 사용료',facility.label,won(facility.amount)]);total+=facility.amount}else{rows.push(['빈소 사용료','공식 확인 금액 없음','미확인']);missing.push('빈소 사용료')}for(const [name,qtyId,priceId] of [['음식·접객','mealCount','mealPrice']]){const q=$safeNumber(qtyId),p=$safeNumber(priceId);if(q>0&&p>0){const value=q*p;rows.push([name,'직접 입력 '+q+'인분 × '+won(p),won(value)]);total+=value}else{rows.push([name,'별도 확인 필요','미확인']);missing.push(name)}}for(const [name,id] of [['화장시설','cremation'],['봉안·장지','burial'],['기타 선택 비용','otherCost']]){const v=$safeNumber(id);if(v>0){rows.push([name,id==='otherCost'?$('otherNote').value||'직접 입력':'직접 입력한 참고액',won(v)]);total+=v}else{rows.push([name,'별도 확인 필요','미확인']);missing.push(name)}}rows.push(['안치실·입관실 등','시설에 별도 확인 필요','미확인']);missing.push('안치실·입관실 등');$('breakdown').innerHTML=rows.map(r=>''+r.map(v=>''+safe(v)+'').join('')+'').join('');$('detailedTotal').textContent=won(total);$('missing').textContent='합계에 포함되지 않은 항목: '+missing.join(', ')+(proof?.sourceGrade?' · 시설자료 등급 '+proof.sourceGrade:'')}
